scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:setup && docker compose up --build
scripts.docker:up:detached: npm run docker:setup && docker compose up --build -d
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec api npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --config config/config.cjs --env docker
